messages.content: Northline Care check-in — week three. Hope you're hanging in there. Any readings to share, or anything on your mind this week?
bp was 134/86 this morning. but i waited two days to hear back after last week and nobody ever called. kind of done with this honestly
Thanks — logging 134/86. I'm sorry the follow-up took that long, I know that's frustrating. Is your medication routine still going okay this week?
yeah meds are fine. I just want off these texts. how do i stop them

I hear you. Opting out isn't something I'm able to do from here — you'd need to contact Northline Care directly to change your enrollment. I've noted that you'd like to stop. Your next scheduled check-in would otherwise be in 7 days.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
